title: 第216章 地狱意志 我不能倒下身后是魔物们的家园第215章 改造地狱私域人造魔法太阳的设想
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
听到奥罗拉的仰头咆哮之声，趴在李凯南膝盖上的卡拉波斯只觉得吵闹，忍不住坐起身来骂了一句：
“蠢龙……”
在周边嘈杂的环境之中，卡拉波斯的声音并不算大。
但此刻的奥罗拉，还是敏锐地捕捉到了卡拉波斯的骂声。
在看到赖在李凯南身边的卡拉波斯，一股暴躁愤怒的情绪瞬间涌上了奥罗拉的心头，那双漂亮的紫罗兰色瞳孔更是沾染上了一丝深邃黑暗。
可还不等她失控暴走，李凯南的【破邪之力】便已经照射在奥罗拉的身上。
纯白圣洁的力量，让因为被地狱力量所影响的奥罗拉瞬间恢复了理智。
因为卡拉波斯的“拔苗助长”，奥罗拉破壳之后便吞噬了不少地狱本源力量，方才用短短十年时间成为了一头成年巨龙。
但也正是因为如此，奥罗拉便很容易受到地狱的影响！
此前只是因为李凯南对地狱造成了损失，让地狱意志没顾得上去侵蚀、影响奥罗拉的灵魂。
如今奥罗拉来到地狱空间，地狱意志对其的影响力必然增加。
所以李凯南早就有所准备，及时出手驱散了奥罗拉体内的地狱邪恶气息！
而此时的地狱意志，显然也注意到了奥罗拉的到来。
外围那些被李凯南的【破邪之力】所阻拦的地狱气息、魔物，此刻先是一阵躁动，旋即又很快诡异地安静了下来。
然后一股强大又邪恶的地狱力量，开始通过和奥罗拉之间千丝万缕的联系，快速侵染她的灵魂。
暴躁的情绪再度充斥在奥罗拉身上，让她再度陷入了失控的边缘。
地狱意志显然想要通过控制奥罗拉，利用巨龙强大的肉身力量去牵制李凯南，以便它能够调动力量击破李凯南的【破邪之力】！
此时的李凯南，显然也注意到了奥罗拉的异常。
他一把推开了还趴伏在自己腿上的卡拉波斯，然后立即起身来到了奥罗拉的身边，调动【破邪之力】帮助她摆脱地狱之力的影响！
李凯南这一推，直接让卡拉波斯重重摔倒在地上。

卡拉波斯抬起头来，脸上甚至不由自主地露出了暗爽的表情……
而也正是因为李凯南的【破邪之力】被调动给奥罗拉，为她驱散体内的地狱之力，让周边屏障力量开始变弱。
整片地狱空间，瞬间从死寂之中苏醒过来。
无边无际的地狱黑雾翻涌不断，数量惊人的魔物仰头嘶吼，然后开始不断冲击着由李凯南体内【破邪之力】所汇聚的守护屏障！
邪恶的地狱黑雾撞上了能够裁决一切邪恶的【破邪之力】，立刻消散为飞灰消散。
那些狰狞畸变的地狱魔物冲进来这纯白圣洁的光辉之下，更是痛苦惨叫、身体蜷缩直至彻底死去……
但即便如此，地狱意志依旧一边在奥罗拉的体内和李凯南对抗着，一边驱使着地狱魔物冲击李凯南【破邪之力】所形成的屏障。
它不能倒下，因为它的身后就是邪恶魔物们赖以生活的无边黑暗。
无论付出多么惨痛的代价，地狱意志都要将李凯南这个侵略家园的敌人赶出去！
而此刻的李凯南，正在全力守护着奥罗拉的灵魂不被地狱之力所侵染。
【破邪之力】的力量被调动分散，也让这处堡垒外围的防护发生了动摇。
content_en:
Hearing Aurora's roaring sound, Carabosse, who was lying on Li Kainan's knees, felt the noise and couldn't help but sit up and cursed:
"Stupid dragon..."
In the noisy surrounding environment, Carabosse's voice was not too loud.
But at this moment, Aurora still keenly caught Carabosse's curse.
When she saw Carabosse lying next to Li Kainan, a violent and angry emotion instantly surged into Aurora's heart, and her beautiful violet pupils were stained with a hint of deep darkness.
But before she could lose control and run away, Li Kainan's [Evil-Destroying Power] had already irradiated Aurora.
The pure white and holy power instantly restored Aurora, who was affected by the power of hell, to her sanity.
Because of Carabosse's "backlash", Aurora devoured a lot of hell's original power after breaking out of her shell, and she became an adult dragon in just ten years.
But precisely because of this, Aurora is easily affected by hell!
Previously, it was just because Li Kainan caused damage to Hell that Hell's will did not bother to corrode and affect Aurora's soul.
Now that Aurora has come to the hell space, the influence of hell's will on her will inevitably increase.
Therefore, Li Kainan had been prepared for a long time and took action in time to dispel the evil breath of hell in Aurora's body!
At this time, Hell's Will obviously also noticed Aurora's arrival.
Those hellish auras and monsters in the periphery that were blocked by Li Kainan's [Evil-Destroying Power] were agitated at first, and then quickly and eerily quieted down.
Then a powerful and evil force from hell began to quickly infect Aurora's soul through its inextricable connections.
The irritable emotions filled Aurora again, bringing her to the edge of losing control again.
The Will of Hell obviously wants to control Aurora and use the dragon's powerful physical power to contain Li Kainan, so that it can mobilize its power to defeat Li Kainan's [Evil-Destroying Power]!
At this time, Li Kainan obviously noticed something unusual about Aurora.
He pushed away Carabosse who was still lying on his lap, and then immediately stood up and came to Aurora's side, mobilizing the [Evil-Breaking Power] to help her get rid of the influence of the power of hell!
Li Kainan's push caused Carabosse to fall heavily to the ground.
Carabosse raised his head, with a secretly happy expression on his face...
And it was precisely because Li Kainan's [Evil-Destroying Power] was mobilized to Aurora to dispel the power of hell in her body that the surrounding barrier power began to weaken.
The entire hell space suddenly woke up from the dead silence.
The boundless black fog of hell surged continuously, and an astonishing number of monsters raised their heads and roared, and then began to continuously attack the protective barrier gathered by the [evil-breaking power] in Li Kainan's body!
The evil black fog of hell collided with the [Evil-Destroying Power] that can judge all evil, and immediately dissipated into flying ash.
Those ferocious and deformed hell monsters rushed in under the pure white and holy light, screaming in pain, curling up until they died completely...
But even so, the will of hell is still fighting against Li Kainan in Aurora's body, while driving the hell monsters to attack the barrier formed by Li Kainan's [Evil-Destroying Power].
It cannot fall, because behind it is the boundless darkness where evil monsters live.
No matter how painful the price is, the will of hell will drive out Li Kainan, the enemy who invaded his homeland!
At this moment, Li Kainan is trying his best to protect Aurora's soul from being infected by the power of hell.
The power of [Evil-Breaking Power] was mobilized and dispersed, which also caused the protection on the outside of the fortress to be shaken.
